name: EmotionQueen
description: Emotional intelligence in large language models (LLMs) is of great importance in Natural Language Processing. However, the previous research mainly focus on basic sentiment analysis tasks, such as emotion recognition, which is not enough to evaluate LLMs' overall emotional intelligence. Therefore, this paper presents a novel framework named EmotionQueen for evaluating the emotional intelligence of LLMs.
reputation: A recent benchmark proposal that is still emerging and has not yet seen broad community adoption.
notes: New benchmark focused on emotional intelligence beyond basic sentiment; likely limited public leaderboard history and possible dataset contamination risk as LLMs proliferate.
